args.title: Tamarack Components Newsletter Summary: Warehouse Automation in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter (Tamarack Components, "Warehouse automation in 2026"): This week's issue points to a main article on warehouse automation trends, with a subscriber-only companion piece offering full charts.
- Main article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks.
